title: Qullunakar ch’allxtayir melodia
intro: Jumax niyaw Allahan mä muspharkañ luqtiripan sarnaqäwip uñt’ayañampïskta. Yatiyirinaka ukat apnaqirinakan oraqenjja, uka jaqejj Diosan mä libropampi, wali chʼamani arupampi ukat hierrot sipansa chʼamampiw bendicitäna. Uka pʼeqeñchäwinak liytʼkasaxa, ¿khitis ukax ukhamäspa uk amuytʼasmati?
clues: Nayax Allahan luqtiripätwa, juparux mä libro especial churapxäna.
Nayajj wali suma arunïyätwa, jachʼañchatajajj wali munatänwa, ukatwa qollunakas jamachʼinakas nayamp chiktʼasipjjäna.
Mä wali uñtʼat nuwasïwinjja, wali ajjsarkañ uñisirimpiw uñkatasiyäta, ukat jukʼamp jiskʼäkchiyätsa, atipjawaytwa.
Hierrojj nayatakejj llampʼu luratäjjänwa, ukhamatwa amparanakajampi armaduranak lurañ yanaptʼitäna.
Nayarojj mä jachʼa marka apnaqirit uttʼayatätwa, taripañ toqet yatiñ kankañajasti wali uñtʼatänwa.
Wawajajj profetarakïnwa, juparojj thayaru ukat jinninakar apnaqañapatakiw churapjjäna.

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
